provenance.semantic_change: None. Only the frozen snapshot bindings, explicit v1 exclusions, and no-go reporting layer are new.
provenance.runtime_equivalence_gate: verify.mjs loads the baseline v1 scanner and requires deep equality of v1 and v2 raw scan outputs before exclusions.

lexicon.corpus: Every maximal Unicode Script=Han run in every target in the frozen canonical inventory.
lexicon.bigram: Overlapping adjacent Han pairs within the same run; a newline is never treated as adjacency.

candidate_rule.base_boundary: A Han character is the last character before LF and another Han character is the first character after optional horizontal indentation.
required: target newline count is greater than source newline count
at least one adjacent line contains 20 Han characters
the cross-boundary bigram occurs contiguously at least twice elsewhere in the target corpus

tiers.Q_QUOTED_TWO_HAN_TOKEN: The boundary is exactly inside a two-Han token enclosed by paired Chinese quotation marks.
tiers.A_FREQUENT_BIGRAM: Not Q; contiguous corpus frequency is at least 5.
tiers.B_LOW_SUPPORT_BIGRAM: Not Q/A; contiguous corpus frequency is 2 to 4.

candidate_rule.list_policy: Do not blanket-exclude a long wrapped line merely because its paragraph contains list items; a split inside a list item's Chinese word is still a candidate.
candidate_rule.output_semantics: Every raw hit remains CANDIDATE_NOT_GROUND_TRUTH. Registered v1 development identities are removed from the independent holdout before any audit or scoring.

qualification_rule: Exactly five raw candidates must be covered one-to-one by EXCLUSIONS.json and exactly zero independent candidates must remain. Any other observation fails closed; the contract must not be weakened.
known_limitations: The PMI threshold misses common functional bigrams such as 不会 and is not a complete word segmenter.
The five current emissions were exposed during v1 development and cannot be scored as independent holdout units.
Zero post-exclusion candidates cannot estimate precision, recall, false-alarm behavior, or cross-component performance.
